name: MineShooterVR
summary:
MineShooter Vr is an engaging endless shooter game designed in space environment.

Shoot the mines and rocks before they hit you 
preserve health
Make a high score

Enjoy this new Occulus based Virtual Reality  game for unlimited period of time.

min shooter VR enables user to experience a whole new 3d world of space environment overloaded and overwhelmed with space rocks , transparent asteroids and translucent mines
